title: Beginner’s Guide to Affiliate Marketing and How to Start

facts.fact: According to PayScale, the average annual income for affiliate marketers is $56,141 in 2025.
facts.quote: According to PayScale, the average annual income for affiliate marketers is [$56,141](https://www.payscale.com/research/US/Job=Affiliate_Marketer/Salary) in 2025

facts.fact: According to PayScale, the top 10% of affiliate marketers earn around $77,000 annually.
facts.quote: with the top 10% earning around $77,000 and the bottom 10% earning $41,000.

facts.fact: In a pay-per-install example, an affiliate could make $.10 for every install of a brand's new app in the first 90 days after launch.
facts.quote: an affiliate could make $.10 for every install of a brand’s new app in the first 90 days after its launch.

facts.fact: In a high-paying, low-volume program example, a company might pay an affiliate $500 per month if they get 50 customers to sign up for a membership program.
facts.quote: a company might pay an affiliate $500 per month if they get 50 customers to sign up for a membership program.

facts.fact: Amazon's affiliate program offers up to 10% commission on promoted products.
facts.quote: offering up to 10% commission on promoted products.

facts.fact: The page states that affiliate marketing works with any platform, including blogs, YouTube channels, Instagram, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
facts.quote: Affiliate marketing works with any platform, from blogs and YouTube channels to Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, and more.

facts.fact: The page states that a common affiliate mistake is overlooking the guidelines a company sets for how its product or service should be shared with customers.
facts.quote: A common mistake is overlooking guidelines for how a company wants their product or service shared with customers.

facts.fact: The page advises affiliates to start small and test partnerships before committing to long-term collaborations.
facts.quote: Start small and test partnerships before committing to long-term collaborations.

facts.fact: The page states that successful affiliate marketing depends on patience and consistency rather than being a get-rich-quick scenario.
facts.quote: It’s easy to think of affiliate marketing as a get-rich-quick scenario, but successful affiliates know that patience and consistency are key.
